messages:
maya: FYI - after rolling the new toolkit images (12.x) to eu-west batch pool, ~10% of GPU jobs are crashing at startup with dynamic symbol errors. Example trace: `dlopen failed: undefined symbol: _ZNKSt6__cxx1112basic_stringIcSt11char_traitsIcESaIcEE4sizeEv`
jon: Seeing similar NCCL init failures in us-west-reorg nodes. Worker processes aborting with SIGABRT right after cuInit(). Logs: `cuInit() -> 999 (unknown error)`, `ncclCommInitRank failed: unhandled cuda error`
ashwin: dump of ldd on the failing binary shows it linking against host libstdc++ mismatch. We built these images with gcc-13 toolchain, but host fleet nodes have driver-provided libstdc++ from driver 525 (glibcxx symbol set differs). Looks like mangled symbol resolution fails at dlopen time.
dana: Confirmed we rebuilt the python wheels inside the image with system libstdc++. Quick repro: run `docker run --rm -it new-toolkit12:latest python -c 'import torch; torch.cuda.device_count()'` and it aborts. Rebuilding wheels with `-D_GLIBCXX_USE_CXX11_ABI=1` didn't fully fix it for some compiled extensions.
maya: infra-bot can you post canary metrics?
infra-bot: Canary alert: gpu-startup-failure-rate increased from 0.6% -> 7.8% in eu-west in the last 30m. Affected tags: toolkit-12-builds, nightly-repro.
jon: We've drained 8 nodes in us-west to stop new jobs from landing. Capacity now at 72% for GPU pool. If this spreads we'll need to spin up reserve capacity which impacts cost.
ops-lead: Stop rollout, rollback plan: 1) Pin cluster routing to toolkit-11 images for eu-west + us-west canaries, 2) Pause all automated image promotions, 3) Open a build ticket to produce abi-compatible images. Target rollback within 60m.
dana: Temporary workaround that worked on one node: LD_PRELOAD=/opt/cuda/lib64/stubs/libstdc++.so.6 allowed the process to start, but it's brittle. Not safe for production.
ashwin: Long-term: we should standardize on NVIDIA base CUDA images (they ship matching libstdc++), and add an image-compatibility CI that runs `dlopen` smoke tests against host libstdc++ versions before promoting. Also will add symbol-version check in the build pipeline.
jon: Deploy-bot, initiate rollback for eu-west canary and block promo into prod.
deploy-bot: Rollback job created #INFRA-2408, triggered by jon. Blocking tag: toolkit-12-promo. Progress: rolling back 12/24 canaries in eu-west.
maya: Cost hit note: we moved ~1200 short GPU jobs to on-demand fallback nodes this morning while isolating affected racks. Early estimate ~ $6.5k/day if this persists. Track in ticket INFRA-2408.
ops-lead: Assigning ashwin and dana to hotfix the image builds, jon to coordinate rollback, maya to monitor canaries and cost. Let's sync in 30m. :thumbsup:
maya: Will post follow-up with root-cause once we have the build diff. Thanks everyone.
